responsibility: Declares GCC’s main tree-folding interface: top-level fold entry points, fold_build* constructors, conversion helpers, constant-expression predicates, pointer/size arithmetic builders, overflow-warning controls, native encoding/decoding helpers, and comparison/range utility functions. It is the umbrella API used across front ends and middle-end passes to request tree simplification, constant evaluation, and canonical expression construction provided by fold-const.cc and related folding code.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the umbrella public interface for the fold-const subsystem, declaring general fold/build helpers and utilities used across GCC; unlike gcc/fold-const.cc it does not implement folding, and unlike gcc/fold-const-call.h it covers the broader expression-folding API rather than only call-folding entry points.
